title: Quantum-Assisted Geometric Attack Analysis
summary: Whether quantum computation can strengthen geometric analysis of classical cryptanalytic attacks and expose new attack techniques remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether quantum computers can aid the theoretical analysis of classical cryptanalytic attacks using the geometric approach and, in particular, whether such quantum-assisted analysis can reveal new cryptanalytic techniques.

scope.domain: Quantum-assisted cryptanalysis using a geometric approach to analyze classical attacks.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether quantum computers can aid geometric theoretical analysis of classical cryptanalytic attacks and reveal new cryptanalytic techniques.

citations.label: A Geometric Approach to Quantum Distinguishers

progress.summary: The paper explicitly presents this as an intriguing open question and suggests that revealing new cryptanalytic techniques could be an outcome of quantum-assisted geometric analysis.
citation_labels: Zhili Wu et al., A Geometric Approach to Quantum Distinguishers
